claims.statement: The wrapper includes the inspected enterprise billing-menu fragment, which points to Billing and licensing at the page top. This is navigation only, not billing access authorization, license rights clearance, financial inspection or actual charge evidence.

The sequence opens Agents and then Copilot Cloud Agent under Available agents. Navigating to this entry is not enabled policy, a launched remote agent, verified work handoff, subscription entitlement or authority to incur costs.

The self-role change sequence first confirms the client is an enterprise owner, then uses the current user's administrator menu to select Billing manager and confirm Change role. This preserves an ownership-continuity prerequisite, but supplies no permission matrix, recovery proof or authority to demote an owner. The screenshot image was not inspected; no roles changed.

The Identity provider sidebar entry is described as the way to review IdP groups. Navigation is not group membership verification, provisioning or synchronization assurance, nor permission to access or change identities.

The Organizations tab appears beneath the enterprise name, with a screenshot caption. This does not supply an actual complete organization census, estate ownership or access proof, and the image was not inspected.

The Azure connection sequence explicitly selects confirmation that metered services should be billed through the selected subscription, then Connect. This is a cost-bearing consent boundary, not informational navigation, observed subscription linkage or approval from this source review; no billing acknowledgment was selected or connection performed.
